docs.title: lcls-lattice
docs.text:
The LCLS accelerator complex consists of multiple electron sources and multiple beam paths.

lcls-lattice is a repository of lattice files for the various accelerators in the LCLS accelerator complex. It also includes scripts for optics codes for developing and analyzing those lattice files.
